authority: The maintainer requested six independent rubric teams plus one independent Idea Model reviewer of product need, expertise, generality and application responsibilities.

source_of_truth.title: Hackathon Rubric 2026
source_of_truth.availability: Organizer-provided reference. Original attachment is not redistributed in this repository.

teams.name: Continuity, MEC deployment and service use

scheduling: Main plus up to three active workers. Schedule the six scoring owners and the independent Idea Model reviewer in waves. Give all reviewers the same frozen revision and evidence bundle.
triggers: Changed criteria after a material change or fix
Integrated application, actual service and agent evidence
Release candidate and final presentation, article, films and GitHub artifacts
review_cycle: Identify revision or file-hash snapshot and evidence bundle
Main records accept, alternative or defer and reason
Delegate bounded implementation tasks with file ownership
Run checks proportionate to changed behavior
Independent reviewer verifies the new evidence
Close as resolved, partially resolved or unresolved; retain deferral rationale
evidence_bundle: Codex installation and runtime readiness evidence
Actual LLM trace versus fixture classification
rationality_gate: Explain why the simpler alternative is inadequate
Explain reuse, integration or operational benefit
Document cost to onboarding and maintenance
evidence_rules: No planned feature receives an implementation score.
Do not invent weights, an official total or N/A policy.
Missing evidence is not automatically zero.
Internal acceptance gates are separate from official rubric descriptors.
Reviewers do not send external messages or publish.
Implementation authors cannot independently close their own findings.
This process runs during active work and milestones; it is not a scheduled background monitor.

idea_model_reviewer.purpose: Independently test whether the proposed product solves a documented facility decision, offers a professionally grounded response and can be configured by other facilities through an agent plugin.
inputs: Problem source and explicit product assumptions
Actor, decision, permitted writes and deployment unit per app
Same inputs with and without the proposed external capability
Same evidence supplied by a simpler local route when available
Observed operator decision, installation effort and independent reuse evidence
triggers: Before architecture freeze or a change to product need, application responsibilities or service selection
First integrated scenario including an agent-authored definition and MEC comparison
Release candidate and final claims or materially revised demo
output: Falsifiable test, verdict, open assumptions and next review
idea_model_reviewer.disposition: Main records adopt, revise or defer with reason and links. Ask this reviewer to recheck with execution evidence after implementation. Rubric grades remain with teams A–F.
